name: steal-this-vault
description: A vault on QoreChain whose owner's ECDSA key is public. Withdrawals also need an ML-DSA-87 signature verified on chain.

scripts.build: npm run build -w contracts && npm run build -w web
scripts.test: npm run test -w contracts && npm run test -w core && npm run test -w cli && npm run test -w keeper && npm run test -w web
scripts.check: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
